description: This file defines the Indonesian locale configuration for the Moment.js library, specifying months, weekdays, date formats, relative time expressions, and week settings specific to the Indonesian language.

methods.name: meridiemHour
methods.description: Converts hour based on the meridiem indicator in Indonesian, adjusting hours for morning, afternoon, evening, and night.

methods.name: meridiem
methods.description: Determines the meridiem label (pagi, siang, sore, malam) based on the hour of the day.
